what: A layering synth with two banks of eight voices, from Lowrey organ flute, harpsichord and strings to a music box and dial-up modem sounds, plus a real Mellotron flute layer, reverb, delay, colour themes and animated icons that come alive as you play.
sounds: licensed: Taijiguy (Bernie Kornowicz) Mellotron M400S flute samples, as prepared by FMEL-1, free to use but not in commercial or for-profit software
